tur31-0: Neviaser proposed the name “adhesive capsulitis” to emphasise the inflammation and thickening of the shoulder capsule.
tur31-1: Reeves, in a study that followed 41 patients for 5–10 years, described phases of pain, stiffness and recovery; the condition lasted 30 months on average, and even after the greatest recovery more than half of the patients were left with slight restriction of movement. The view that it “goes away on its own” is most often based on this study.
